evidence.provenance: Controlled framework experiment, not a reconstructed crash report.
evidence.assumptions: Calibrated to the observed InterFuser cruise near 5 m/s: ADS initial 5 m/s; NPC target 3 m/s; initial adjacent longitudinal offset 24 m; lane change over 7.5 m (nominal 2.5 s at target speed). These are explicit experimental parameters. Collision pairing identifies the tested interaction and does not mandate a collision.
